meta.project_name_cn: 电商增长 Agent 工作台
meta.revision_note: Step 12 revised in place to align with E-commerce Growth Agent Studio V2 positioning and product naming constraints.

responsibility_boundary: Convert the standardized Brief and upstream structured artifacts into an executable V2 workflow plan.
Define task decomposition, node routing, node input/output contracts, risk routing, human approval fields, evaluation targets, and downstream handoff fields.
Preserve existing compliance gates and blocked final generation states.
planner_scope.positioning_guardrail: This is a ToB Agent Workflow / Skills product for enterprise ecommerce teams. The demo product is 运动相机 in a smart imaging device launch scenario, not a single-brand, single-model, or single-product tool. Image-quality parameters require source evidence and review.

source_files.missing_file_handling: Missing optional portfolio navigation files were recorded where applicable and do not block Step 12. This revision used only active workspace files.

demo_context.product_naming_rule: Use 运动相机 as the only demo product name. Do not use parameter-prefixed product names, specific brand names, or specific model names.
demo_context.parameter_review_rule: HD and panorama parameters require source evidence and proof review; without evidence they must be needs_review or blocked.

v2_route_summary: Brief Parser normalizes and validates the input brief.
Planner Agent creates the governed V2 execution plan before downstream orchestration.
Audience Insight, Selling Point Analyst, and Platform Strategy may run in parallel after the standardized Brief is available.
Creative Agent waits for Audience Insight, Selling Point Analyst, and Platform Strategy outputs to be completed and summarized.
Brand Compliance must run before Human Approval.
Human Approval records approved, needs_revision, or blocked before Image Prompt Skill proceeds.
Image Prompt Skill remains a single node and must run after Human Approval in the V2 workflow.
Growth Evaluation Agent reads both compliance conclusions and human approval results before evaluation.
Final Report Generator summarizes the complete execution record and governed artifact index.

routing_rules.description: Audience Insight, Selling Point Analyst, and Platform Strategy can execute in parallel after standardized_brief_summary is available.
Creative Agent must wait for the three analysis outputs to be summarized before creating creative module structures.
Brand Compliance must evaluate structured creative and visual planning risks before Human Approval.
Image Prompt Skill must remain a single node and may only proceed after Human Approval records approved, needs_revision, or blocked in the V2 governed route.
Growth Evaluation Agent must use compliance status and approval decisions before scoring workflow performance.

v2_workflow_sequence: Audience Insight Skill / Selling Point Analyst Agent / Platform Strategy Skill

node_execution_plan.status_rule: Stop workflow if required fields are missing or schema validation fails.
Mark assumptions and low-confidence insights for review.
Any claim without proof must be tagged as needs_review or blocked for final generation.
KPI language must remain observational and may not become commercial outcome promises.
Generate structure and module requirements only; do not generate final public-facing copy.
Must run before Human Approval and must preserve blocked gates for final generation until evidence and authorization are confirmed.
Approval must be separated by operations, brand, legal/compliance, and asset authorization responsibilities.
Remain a single node. Do not split into separate visual nodes. Do not generate final image prompts or images without explicit approval and authorization.
Evaluate workflow performance and field quality; never convert KPI observations into guaranteed business outcomes.
Summarize governed workflow, traceability, approvals, evaluation results, and remaining blocked items.

parallel_execution_groups.reason: All downstream analysis depends on a standardized and validated brief.
These nodes can all read standardized brief context and produce complementary analysis artifacts.
Creative structure depends on summarized analysis; compliance must review risk before humans approve.
Post-approval nodes require compliance and human decision fields. Image Prompt Skill remains a single governed node.

high_risk_fields.field_group: 高清 / 全景等画质参数（仅限原始 Brief 有证明时）
high_risk_fields.risk_reason: HD and panorama quality parameters may become unsupported superiority or unconditional image-quality claims if proof is missing.
required_evidence: source brief field showing the parameter
approved comparison criteria if comparison is used

high_risk_fields.field_group: 防水 / 防抖 / 耐用
high_risk_fields.risk_reason: May imply any-condition waterproofing, drop resistance, stabilization, or no-damage guarantees.
May imply guaranteed viral content, professional results, or zero learning cost.

high_risk_fields.field_group: GMV / 转化 / 流量 / CTR / CVR 承诺
high_risk_fields.risk_reason: Business metrics may only be observations or test fields, not promised outcomes.
required_evidence: actual campaign data for retrospective use only

high_risk_fields.field_group: 品牌 Logo / 名人肖像 / 商标 / 肖像权
high_risk_fields.risk_reason: Unauthorized marks or likeness may create IP, trademark, or publicity-rights risks.

high_risk_fields.field_group: 商品图 / App 截图 / 场景样片 / 达人素材
high_risk_fields.risk_reason: Final multimodal assets require proof of usage rights and source traceability.
required_evidence: creator or model release if applicable

risk_budget.budget_rule: Any critical risk blocks final copy, final image prompt, image generation, and public release until evidence and human approval are recorded.

agent_workflow_metrics.definition: Percentage of planned nodes that produce valid structured artifacts without blocking errors.
Average time from node start to valid artifact output, measured per node and for the full workflow.
Percentage of fields changed by human reviewers after agent output.
Percentage of claims, assets, or assumptions not supported by source brief, upstream artifacts, evidence, or approvals.
Percentage of risky items caught by Brand Compliance or Human Approval before final generation.
Percentage of required schema fields populated in each artifact and handoff packet.
Categorized reasons for node failure, including missing field, unsupported claim, asset authorization gap, schema error, dependency missing, or human rejection.

blocked_items.reason: Requires evidence, brand/legal review, and Human Approval.
Requires Human Approval and asset authorization; Image Prompt Skill must remain a single node.
Requires final prompt approval and asset rights confirmation.
Requires final asset approval, campaign owner release decision, and platform compliance.
Step 12 only plans the V2 workflow and inherits existing artifacts.

blocked_items.item: using technical parameters as the product name or as default product facts
blocked_items.reason: The demo product name must be 运动相机. Image-quality parameters require source evidence and review.

to_human_approval_node.purpose: Enable role-based human review of claims, compliance risk, assets, platform metrics, and next allowed nodes.

to_growth_evaluation_agent.purpose: Evaluate agent workflow efficiency, quality, risk interception, field completeness, and failure reasons after approval decisions are available.

to_final_report_generator.purpose: Summarize V2 workflow orchestration, governance gates, evaluation readiness, and remaining blocked final-generation items for portfolio review.
